routing_rationale.skill_match: autoresearch-composer SKILL.md describes a portable iterative-research composer with a state machine (OBJECTIVE_BOUND → EVALUATOR_FROZEN → BASELINE_BOUND → CANDIDATE_GENERATED → MATCHED_EXPERIMENT_RUN → RESULT_VALIDATED → {ADOPT|REJECT|ITERATE|BLOCK} → HANDOFF) that directly models a bounded optimization loop.
core_laws_satisfied: CORE-LAW-001: objective (maximize lint_pass_rate) and evaluator (numeric verifier) are frozen before candidate generation.
CORE-LAW-002: baseline and candidate runs share the same linter binary, version, config, and file set.
CORE-LAW-003: pass rate is measured by the verifier, not inferred from candidate description.
CORE-LAW-004: the invariant guard (no suppression, no regression) is encoded in Guard.invariants and cannot be widened by modules.
CORE-LAW-005: iteration budget is 5, with terminal states PASS/STALLED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/BLOCK/HARD_REGRESSION.
alternatives_rejected: autoresearch:fix — narrow repair loop, lacks the objective/evaluator freeze and matched-experiment protocol required here.
tdd — test-coverage focus, not lint-metric optimization.
Manual iteration — no invariant guard or budget enforcement.
